description: This file contains implementation of the im2col operation optimized for Apple MPS backend, including functions for tensor transformation and dispatching GPU kernels using Metal.

methods.name: im2col_out_mps_template
methods.description: Performs the im2col transformation on the input tensor, preparing data for Metal performance shader execution.

methods.name: im2col_out_mps
methods.description: Wrapper function that calls the template implementation for the im2col operation and outputs to a provided tensor.

methods.name: im2col_mps
